inline.text: Langfuse: judges run asynchronously in the Langfuse worker on ingested traces; nothing runs inside your application.

self_hosted.text: Langfuse: open source and self-hosted with Docker; some add-on features need a license key.

cost_class.text: Langfuse: one judge-model call per evaluation; the cost depends on the judge model and the input size, and sampling keeps it down.

explanations.text: Langfuse: the judge returns a score together with its reasoning.

calibration.text: Langfuse: calibrate a judge against labelled examples, or compare its scores with human annotation scores.

inline.text: Guardrails AI: input and output guards run in your application and intercept what goes into and comes out of the LLM.

self_hosted.text: Guardrails AI: an open-source Python framework under the Apache-2.0 license.

cost_class.text: NeMo Guardrails: the self-check facts rail asks an LLM whether each response follows from the evidence, one more LLM call per checked answer; AlignScore and third-party rails are alternatives.

explanations.text: Not documented (as of 2026-10-10): the NeMo Guardrails self-check facts rail returns an accuracy score.

calibration.text: NeMo Guardrails: an evaluation tool measures rails, fact-checking included, on datasets; fitting thresholds to your own labels is not documented (as of 2026-10-10).

rows.name: Cloud groundedness APIs
rows.examples: Bedrock contextual grounding, Azure groundedness detection

inline.text: Amazon Bedrock: the contextual grounding check runs on each response through the Invoke or Converse APIs, or on its own through ApplyGuardrail.

self_hosted.text: Not documented (as of 2026-10-10): the contextual grounding check is part of the managed Amazon Bedrock Guardrails service.

cost_class.text: Amazon Bedrock: billed per text unit, counting the grounding source, the query and the response.

explanations.text: Azure: reasoning mode explains each ungrounded segment; the faster non-reasoning mode answers grounded or ungrounded only.

calibration.text: Amazon Bedrock: you set the grounding and relevance thresholds that filter responses; a calibration workflow is not documented (as of 2026-10-10).

inline.text: Galileo: Luna-2 is built for real-time evaluations and runtime protection; how it sits in your request path is not documented on this page (as of 2026-10-10).

self_hosted.text: Galileo: Luna-2 is in the Enterprise tier and can be self-hosted on-prem or in your cloud; an open-source release is not documented (as of 2026-10-10).

cost_class.text: Galileo: a small fine-tuned model scores each metric, which Galileo says lowers latency and cost compared with LLM judges; no public per-answer price is documented (as of 2026-10-10).

explanations.text: Not documented (as of 2026-10-10): Luna-2 scores a metric from the probabilities of True and False tokens.

calibration.text: Galileo: Luna Studio fine-tunes a metric and scores it against your human-labelled test set.
